## New Settings Categories

### Database (3 settings)
- `pool_size`: Database connection pool size (default: 5, range: 1-20)
- `max_overflow`: Maximum overflow connections (default: 10, range: 0-50)
- `pool_recycle_seconds`: Connection recycle time (default: 3600, range: 300-86400)

### API Timeouts (8 settings)
- `openai_timeout`: OpenAI API timeout (default: 120s)
- `elevenlabs_timeout`: ElevenLabs TTS timeout (default: 60s)
- `elevenlabs_dialogue_timeout`: Dialogue generation timeout (default: 300s)
- `github_timeout`: GitHub API timeout (default: 180s)
- `github_upload_timeout`: GitHub upload timeout (default: 180s)
- `http_default_timeout`: Default HTTP timeout (default: 30s)
- `ffmpeg_timeout`: FFmpeg processing timeout (default: 300s)
- `audio_download_timeout`: Audio download timeout (default: 300s)

### TTS (1 setting)
- `rate_limit_delay`: ElevenLabs rate limit delay (default: 1.0s)

### Discovery (2 settings)
- `max_entries_per_feed`: Max episodes per feed (default: 50)
- `max_story_arcs_context`: Max story arcs in extraction context (default: 20)
